name: gym-management
description: Production Ready Sophisticated Gym Management Web Application built with Laravel 13, PostgreSQL 18, and Offline Bootstrap 5.3 + FontAwesome 6.

scripts.copy-assets: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); function copy(src, dest) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); } copy('node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css', 'public/vendor/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css'); copy('node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js', 'public/vendor/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js'); copy('node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css', 'public/vendor/fontawesome/css/all.min.css'); copy('node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.js', 'public/vendor/chartjs/chart.umd.js'); console.log('Assets bundled locally to public/vendor successfully!');"
